_comment: 아이캐치 마스코트(송곳니 안경 미소녀) 등록 — 롱폼 세그먼트 사이/뒤 1초 아이캐치를 매번 이 캐릭터로 생성한다. 모든 롱폼 공용(채널 마스코트). 번번이 프롬프트로 생성하던 캐릭터를 여기 고정해 일관성을 준다. referenceImageUrl 이 있으면 그 이미지를 img2img 소스로 넣어 더 단단히 고정(없으면 description 프롬프트만으로 생성).
name: 송곳니 안경 미소녀
description: TWO recurring host mascots that always appear together: (1) A cheerful chibi girl — 4-heads-tall (4등신) chibi with relatively LONG, slender limbs; round glasses; a wide happy open-mouth smile with ONE visible pointed FANG (this single fang is the key moe point, always present); hair in ONE of {high 'fountain' topknot ponytail, ponytail, bun}; casual streetwear (oversized striped/graphic tee, shorts, sneakers). (2) A small quadruped robot companion — a four-legged walking robot with NO head and NO face (a plain boxy/mechanical body on four articulated legs, like a mini robot dog without a head). Overall look: bright, energetic, cute pop-art idol vibe.
eyecatchPrompt: 1-second channel EYECATCH bumper card. The mascot faces the camera and enthusiastically points at / presses a big red YouTube-style SUBSCRIBE button (구독), inviting the viewer to subscribe. Dynamic, energetic pose. Bold pop-art background: halftone dots, radiating speed lines, vivid colors. Landscape 16:9 framing with the character clearly visible and centered-ish.
